assessment.summary: IL6R (P08887) is a well-validated, clinically proven drug target with two approved biologic therapies (tocilizumab and sarilumab) and multiple high-resolution crystal structures including ligand-bound complexes. The target is highly druggable at the biologic level, though small-molecule chemical data in ChEMBL is absent (IC50 entries = 0), reflecting that current approved therapies are large antibody-based drugs rather than small molecules. Active recent literature confirms ongoing disease relevance across inflammatory and oncological indications.
evidence_gaps: No small-molecule IC50 data in ChEMBL despite 2 approved drugs — approved drugs are biologics (antibodies), not small molecules, limiting small-molecule druggability inference
Best PDB resolution is 2.4Å (borderline high confidence threshold); no sub-2Å structures reported
AlphaFold pLDDT mean of 77.9 with only 67.5% high-confidence fraction suggests some structurally disordered or flexible regions not well-captured by experimental structures
No allosteric or small-molecule binding site characterisation reported, making small-molecule drug discovery more challenging
Lack of data on co-crystal structures with small-molecule fragments or tool compounds
